formal_mechanism.parent_cut: Reuse the frozen canonical min-variable-cut parent. Gate is entered only when parent terminal is OPEN_MINCUT_BRANCH_BUDGET and raw branch_enumerations=0.
formal_mechanism.old_gate_control: The v2.9 full-cut-anchor join-tree carrier must not already admit the no-anchor positive component; positive control requires its no-anchor terminal.
formal_mechanism.singleton_component: For a one-relation cut component, project existing raw rows to B only when that relation contains all B; store one original row witness per projected B-state.
formal_mechanism.two_relation_component: For component C={R1,R2}, require scope(R1) union scope(R2) contains B. Enumerate only explicit row pairs (r1,r2), accept a pair iff equal on every shared variable, and project the merged pair to B.
formal_mechanism.derived_boundary_factor: P_C is the deduplicated set of B-projections of compatible explicit row pairs. Store one original row-pair witness per sigma in P_C.
formal_mechanism.global_carrier: H = intersection_C P_C across all cut components.
formal_mechanism.exact_equivalence: For the frozen scope, F is SAT iff H is nonempty. Each sigma in P_C has an explicit compatible original row witness for every relation in C; components share only cut variables after B deletion.
formal_mechanism.reconstruction: Choose sigma in H, retrieve one stored original row (singleton) or compatible original row pair (two-relation component), merge on B and verify every original relation tuple.
formal_mechanism.quadratic_bound: For a two-relation component, compatible pairs <= |R1|*|R2| and derived support <= compatible pairs. Since explicit row counts are <= O(L), construction/output are <= O(L^2) per component before deduplication.
formal_mechanism.global_bound: Number of components/relations is <= O(L); naive total pair comparisons <= O(L^3) under the explicit encoding, still one fixed polynomial. No chain of relation joins is allowed in this gate.
formal_mechanism.forbidden_generalization: A component with three or more relations returns OPEN before any join chain. This gate does not infer a polynomial envelope for arbitrary-length elimination.

negative_controls.reason: Do not turn a quadratic one-join theorem into an arbitrary elimination chain.

complexity_claim.two_relation_pair_join: O(|R1|*|R2|*arity) naive candidate; <= fixed polynomial in L
complexity_claim.all_components: At most O(L) relations/components, yielding a conservative fixed polynomial O(L^3*arity) envelope
complexity_claim.reconstruction: One stored row or row-pair witness per accepted global state used
